title_en: Application for Transfer of Graduate Course Credits for the 2026 Fall Semester (Semester 2) (Bachelor's to Master's, Master's to Doctoral)
summary: Graduate students who wish to have course credits earned in their Seoul National University bachelor's or master's programme counted toward their current graduate programme must apply online and submit the printed application and a transcript to the department office by 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 21 September 2026. Eligible courses must be in the same or a similar major with a grade of B0 or higher, and limits of 6 credits (bachelor's to master's) and 12 credits (master's to doctoral) apply.
applies_to: Graduate students who wish to have credits completed between the bachelor's and master's programmes, or between the master's and doctoral programmes, counted together. Only credits completed in Seoul National University bachelor's and master's programmes are eligible; credits from other universities are not. Students who have already been approved may not apply again. Students are asked to apply in their first semester after admission.

translation:
Application for Transfer of Graduate Course Credits for the 2026 Fall Semester (Semester 2) (Bachelor's to Master's, Master's to Doctoral)
Posted: 12 September 2026

1. Who should apply
Graduate students who wish to have credits completed between the bachelor's and master's programmes, or between the master's and doctoral programmes, recognised together (credit transfer).
※ For smooth academic administration, please apply in your first semester after admission. Students who have already been approved may not apply again.
※ Only credits completed in Seoul National University bachelor's and master's programmes are eligible (credits from other universities are not eligible).

2. Online application and submission of documents
a. Deadline: by 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 21 September 2026.
b. After applying online, print the application and submit it to the staff member in charge at the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
* Path: 마이스누(Mysnu) > 학생서비스 (Student Services) > 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) > 학점인정신청 (Credit Recognition Application) > 과정간 통산인정 (Inter-programme Credit Transfer) > 신청하기 (Apply) > 신청서 출력 (Print Application) > your own signature and your academic advisor's signature (or seal) on the application are required > submit to the staff member in charge at the department office.
* If you are not a new student admitted in the 2026 Fall Semester (Semester 2), write your year and semester of admission in pencil below your signature on the application form.
* Documents to submit: please submit the credit transfer application form (printed from the system) together with your transcript, with the courses you are applying for marked.
* How to apply: refer to the attachment (Guide to Applying for Transfer of Graduate Course Credits). The content of the attachment was not read.

3. Credits eligible for transfer
★ Eligible courses: courses in the same or a similar major with a grade of B0 or higher. ※ S/U courses are not eligible.
★ Even if a course is a graduate-level course, it may not be recognised for credit transfer if its content is at the undergraduate level of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering [전기정보공학부].
☆ Courses not recognised: (Graduate School of Data Science [데이터사이언스대학원]) 'Programming for Data Science' [데이터사이언스를 위한 프로그래밍] and 'Foundations of Mathematics and Statistics for Data Science' [데이터사이언스를 위한 수학과 통계의 기초].

a. Credit transfer from bachelor's to master's
1) Maximum: up to 6 credits.
2) Of the graduate courses taken during your Seoul National University bachelor's programme, only those shown with the course classification '대학원' (Graduate) are eligible for credit transfer.
3) Courses shown as '일선' (General Elective), '전선' (Major Elective), '전필' (Major Required), etc. had their classification changed so that they could count toward undergraduate graduation credits, and therefore cannot be transferred.

b. Credit transfer from master's to doctoral
1) Maximum: up to 12 credits.
2) Credit transfer is possible only for students who progressed from the master's programme to the doctoral programme in the Seoul National University Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering [전기정보공학부] (including '전컴'), and only for course credits completed in the master's programme in excess of 24 credits.
Example: If you took 27 credits in the master's programme, 3 credits in addition to the 24 credits are recognised.
3) Of the credits completed in the master's programme, only 6 credits of thesis research [논문연구] are recognised. If your thesis research credits exceed 6, the excess must be deducted from the credits transferred.
Example 1: 30 credits completed in the master's programme, 6 credits of thesis research
→ Master's credits completed (30) − credits required for completion of the master's programme (24) = 6 credits transferred.
Example 2: 30 credits completed in the master's programme, 9 credits of thesis research
→ Master's credits completed (30) − credits required for completion of the master's programme (24) − excess thesis research credits (3) = 3 credits transferred.

- Attachment: Guide to Applying for Transfer of Graduate Course Credits
- Enquiries: the department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person's details are given in the original notice.
※ When calculating excess credits from the master's programme, departments that do not count common competency courses [공통역량 교과목] toward completion credits will exclude those credits. Please check with the department office whether this applies to you.
※ For detailed items to check, please refer to the attached guidance dated 7 September 2026.
